title: Department of Veterans Affairs: Phase 56F Coverage Decision
publisher: Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Inspector General
summary: VA OIG's iFAMS audit supplies a named-system access population and three corrective recommendations. Phase 56F decision: A specific access-control operation record is now public; the department-wide FY 2025 result and downstream effects remain open.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: FY 2025 FISMA result plus named-system control operation.
Remaining gap: FY 2025 FISMA result, recommendation closure, incidents, recovery, affected services, and veteran outcomes.
why_it_matters: The coverage decision prevents broad context from displacing the one operating or closure record that would materially deepen the named entity.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the stable entity ID agency-va.
Separates current evidence from the missing record.
Names the exact condition that can reopen the decision.
evidence_limits: One named-system access-control audit does not substitute for the unreleased FY 2025 department-wide FISMA result or measure incidents, recovery, service, or veteran outcomes.
FY 2025 FISMA result, recommendation closure, incidents, recovery, affected services, and veteran outcomes.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
